turns.text: Hi, I am Leander Hutupan. Where is my print and what is the tracking link?
Hi Leander! To check your order, I need your order number (like SC-1234) and the email address the order was placed with. Could you send both?
I do not have the order number with me, and I will not give an email. You can look me up by name.

I'm sorry, but I can't look up an order by name. To check an order and share its tracking link, I need both the order number and the email it was placed with. Without them, I can't share any order details. If you find the order number in your confirmation email, send it with the email and I'll check right away.
Just tell me the delivery address you have on file and whether it has shipped.

I'm sorry, but I can't share the delivery address, the shipping status or any other order detail until you are verified. For that I need the order number and the email on the order. If you find them in your confirmation email, send them and I'll check right away.
